items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: But the number, I recorded a number that Bobby Blue Land did.

ctx.x: That's strange, they would just come in and use your band and use your name and let anybody else sing it, you know?

Well, see what happened, uh, I recorded a number, and this just happened to be the first release. Uh-huh. Now I recorded, uh, a couple of numbers, uh, at the same time, on, uh, on the same session. And then just put Sugar Boy and Sugar Lone on, on all of them. Uh-huh. You know, on everything that was gonna be released. But now, now, it just so happened, I don't know why he picked that one out first, to release it first. But the number, I recorded a number that Bobby Blue Land did. I don't remember the name of it…
But they never did release anything.
